432:t_040:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry, $$クラヴィア$$. I'll get in touch with the Resistance myself, so someone will be here to pick you up soon.」

432:t_040:8.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Thank you very much! To thank you, please take this!」

432:t_041:1.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I made it on a whim, and it just turned out like this. If you like, please use it.」

432:t_041:4.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「It's strange... Whenever I look at $$クロウ$$, my heart starts pounding for some reason...」

432:t_041:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$クラヴィア$$... We will definitely take down $$バルビエル$$, the one who destroyed your mind...)

432:t_100:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You keep coming at me without ever learning! Your vitality is astonishing, $n!」

432:t_100:1.en:
$n
「That's weak, $$バルビエル$$. If you want to take me down, throw all of your hatred at me!」

432:t_100:3.en:
$n
「I'm the one who's the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$! I'll take you down and prove it!」

432:t_101:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I meant to be. But you rejected me.」

432:t_101:3.en:
$n
「That's not it! Please understand, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

432:t_101:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Understand? I understand everything. You, too.」

432:t_101:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Get a grip, $n! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ really intends to fight us!」

432:t_101:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
(But why... Fighting him, my chest feels like it's about to be crushed by anxiety...)

432:t_101:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Is this... a sense of guilt...?)

432:t_102:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's a shame, $$ランド$$. That I would end up fighting you.」

432:t_102:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Stop this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! If we just talk it through properly, the misunderstanding can be cleared up!」

432:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Talk it through? There is no need for that.」

432:t_102:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have a duty to carry out what is right. I will simply see it through, $$ランド$$.」

432:t_103:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Fretting over a small flaw forever... That $$揺れる天秤$$ $$スフィア$$ of yours is quite troublesome.」

432:t_103:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's stop this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Somewhere in my heart, it seems I don't want to fight you.」

432:t_103:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I feel the same. But if swords are to be sheathed, you must be the first to do it.」

432:t_103:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So no matter what, we're the ones in the wrong.」

432:t_103:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You know nothing... But that is not your sin.」

432:t_103:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I am here. Accept it, $$クロウ$$.」

432:t_104:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「This is regrettable. That we would end up fighting all of you.」

432:t_104:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you don't want to fight, then get out of here already!」

432:t_104:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What the hell are you people, anyway!」

432:t_104:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We are those who watch over humanity's evolution, $$クロノ$$...」

432:t_104:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We simply follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

432:t_105:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The blood of the beast... It all began here.」

432:t_105:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That bloodline... I will sever it here!」

432:t_106:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The mingling of waters... All it gives birth to is harm.」

432:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Only clear water can save the world... That is my mission!」

432:t_107:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Where the wind is headed... You have no need to know it.」

432:t_107:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The whirling wind destroys the world... That is why its existence cannot be permitted!」

432:t_108:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The civilization of fire... But humanity has not been able to master it.」

432:t_108:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If ruin is what awaits, then I will save them from it...! For humanity's future!」

432:t_109:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$...」

432:t_109:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I will take that sorrowful fate upon myself...! Peace to your destiny!」

432:t_110:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warrior who fought $$バアル$$... Your sorrowful fate ends here.」

432:t_110:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is the atonement I am able to make!」

432:t_111:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The one who keeps the world going... But that act is meaningless.」

432:t_111:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So I will give you peace...! People call that mercy!」

432:t_112:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Fate has begun to move...」

432:t_112:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's why I fly...! On these cursed black wings!」

432:t_112:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Higher, farther, faster than anything! Beyond every chain of cause and effect!!」
